# Manual transcription rules

This protected package is a page-by-page workspace for careful human
transcription and proofreading. It does not import anything into پېڅوَل.

1. The visible scanned page is authoritative.
2. Reproduce the original text exactly.
3. Do not modernize spelling.
4. Do not silently correct apparent errors.
5. Do not invent titles.
6. Preserve line breaks deliberately.
7. Preserve punctuation where visible.
8. Preserve date and place information exactly where present.
9. Mark unclear text for owner review instead of guessing.
10. No page becomes `APPROVED FOR IMPORT` until it has been checked against
    the scan.
11. No transcription enters production automatically.

Use only these statuses during later work:

- `UNTRANSCRIBED`
- `TRANSCRIBED — NEEDS REVIEW`
- `OWNER REVIEWED`
- `APPROVED FOR IMPORT`

Every transcription file in this initial package is intentionally empty and
has status `UNTRANSCRIBED`. Do not use OCR, hidden PDF text, AI reconstruction,
or guessing to fill it. Page type and poem or section boundaries must be
decided later from visible source evidence during human review. Preserve cover,
title, publication, dedication, introduction, poetry, and other front-matter
pages without assuming that every page is poetry.
